description: [alias of cuba_ingesta] Bulk knowledge ingestion. 'ingest': array of {entity_name, content, observation_type} items. 'parse': split long text by paragraphs + heuristic classify. 'auto_extract' (v0.11): the calling client's LLM extracts salient durable facts from a turn/conversation via MCP Sampling ($0, no API key) and ingests them — the automatic-extraction that mem0/Zep have. All routes share the dedup/PE-gating/embedding pipeline; none delete.

action.description: Ingestion mode. Default 'ingest' is the fast raw path (no LLM). 'parse' splits long text. 'auto_extract' is opt-in LLM extraction via MCP sampling — do not use it as the default write.

allow_secret.description: Refused when the text looks like a live credential (token, password, URL with embedded creds). Set true only for a false match — the text is then stored verbatim, in clear, and reachable by search, export and every client.

entity_hint.description: Optional main-subject hint for auto_extract (biases entity_name)

entity_name.description: Entity to attach parsed observations to (for parse action)

items.description: Array of {entity_name, content, observation_type?} objects (for ingest action, max 200)

supersede_conflicts.description: v0.11 (auto_extract): when a new fact replaces/contradicts an existing related one, ask the judge and mark the old observation superseded (knowledge-update; never deletes). Default false.

text.description: Raw text: paragraphs to split (parse) or a turn/conversation to extract facts from (auto_extract)

untrusted.description: Set when the text came from somewhere you do not control (a fetched page, a pasted document, a third party). Everything extracted lands quarantined — stored and inspectable via cuba_eco action=pending, but withheld from cuba_faro until promoted. Default false.

name: memory_ingesta
